agenda_items: Identify key content types requiring immediate accessibility remediation
Assign roles and responsibilities for the next audit phase
Discuss initial findings from content audit pilot program
Review current content accessibility guidelines and standards (WCAG 2.1 AA)
key_decisions: Prioritize accessibility remediation for all new content immediately
Mandate accessibility training for all content creators within the next few weeks
Establish a dedicated accessibility content review step before publication
Develop a phased approach for auditing and updating existing legacy content, starting with high-traffic pages
attendees: Mr. Jian Li, Senior Content Writer
Ms. Chloe Dubois, Audience Engagement Specialist
